run_inference_cli: run the inference CLI with --checkpoint_file to generate audio from vocal codes
run_vc_inference: run voice conversion inference using --vc flag with a multi-speaker checkpoint
run_debug_inference: run single-threaded debug inference with --debug flag to process items sequentially
run_batch_inference: run batch inference on a manifest file using --input_code_file with multiprocessing
run_inference_with_f0: run inference with F0 statistics using --f0-stats for pitch-aware voice conversion
